leadText: Pocket Monster: Liko's treasure (Japanese: ポケットモンスター～リコの宝物～ Pocket Monsters ~Liko's Treasure~) is a series by おりとかほり Kahori Orito. It is an adaptation of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It was serialized in the Ciao magazine, with a four page prologue in the May 2023 issue (released on April 3, 2023) and regular chapters from the June 2023 issue (released on May 2, 2023) to the August 2023 issue (released on July 3, 2023). It is 112 pages long.
